method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Groups list matches, but the reference shows per-group counts, Cantonese sublabels and a group filter field; built shows counts only and no filter field.
Selecting the root group lists no entries in the built app; the reference lists every entry recursively with health dots, tag chips and relative dates.
Title/Modified/Health segmented control conforms; the Breached/Weak/Reused/Healthy health chips are absent.
Built pane is a plain form; the reference is a card with a health banner, copyable field rows, custom fields, notes and attachments.
Search field with regex chip and builder affordance.

defects.summary: Root group selection lists no entries (reference lists recursively)
Health chips and group filter field missing
Detail pane lacks the reference card anatomy with per-field copy actions

deviations.reason: The fixture root group is named 'Passwords' by keepassxc-cli db-create; the reference names it 'Personal'. Data, not chrome.
